simple.meaning: מָעוּף (mâʻûwph) is a Hebrew object word meaning “darkness.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Isaiah 8:22. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.

simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

definitions.full: H4588. mauph [ מָעוּף ] noun [masculine] id.; — construct צוּקָה מְעוּף Isa 8:22 (|| הֲשֵׁכָה ); Che Hpt. reads מוּעַף . תְּעֻפָה noun feminine id.; — so read probably for תָּעֻ֫פָה Job 11:17 (opposed to כֹּקֶר ).
definitions.rootNote: from 5774 in the sense of covering with shade (compare 4155 );

occurrences.englishText: and look to the earth, and see distress, darkness, and the gloom of anguish. They will be driven into thick darkness.
